captions.story: Deep at the bottom of the Black Sea lies a massive underwater graveyard frozen in time for thousands of years.

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of the Black Sea?
story.summary: In this episode, we explore the anoxic zone at the bottom of the Black Sea, where zero oxygen has preserved over sixty ancient shipwrecks perfectly intact for thousands of years.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of the Black Sea?
